text: Residents on Highview Avenue in the Downsview neighbourhood have reported concerns with motorists parking on the west side of Highview Avenue, in close proximity to the all-way stop sign controlled intersection with Downsview Avenue. These parked motorists impede turning vehicles at this intersection, which may include school buses. In order to deter this activity, it is recommended that parking be prohibited at all times on the west side of Highview Avenue, between Downsview Avenue and the first driveway on the west side of the street. The proposed changes will improve the flow of traffic and will result in the loss of approximately two on-street parking spaces. Transportation Services has been working with my office regarding the changes to the parking regulations on Highview Avenue and is in support of the recommendations.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the prohibition of parking at all times on the west side of Highview Avenue, between Downsview Avenue and a point 29 metres north.
